description: Search HolidayFox for UK holiday accommodation — farm stays, glamping, shepherd huts, caravan and camping pitches, and self-catering cottages. Filter by area and by amenity/audience tags. When checkinDate and checkoutDate are supplied, each result carries the live total price for that exact stay and only genuinely bookable options are counted. Returns destination ids used by the other tools.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search.

area.description: Region key, lowercase and hyphenated, e.g. "cornwall", "north-devon", "peak-district".

checkinDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Supply with checkoutDate for live stay pricing.

numDogs.description: Dogs in the party. Affects availability at dog-friendly sites; not a separate charge here.

name: search_stays
title: Search HolidayFox stays
